scope: Actual production-preview rendering and UI journeys after accepted-main integration. Network and worker examples are simulated or blocked by unconfigured live policy.
limits: Native-frame timestamps and model matrices are in integration-native; settled Playwright transition captures are not precise animation timing evidence.
Headless tab switching did not expose native document.hidden. Visibility handler uses an explicitly simulated property/event; no OS background-throttling claim.
WebGL initialization fallback is deliberately injected; runtime context loss is forced through WEBGL_lose_context.
200% equivalent reflow uses a 720x500 CSS viewport at 2x device scale; this is not an OS/browser zoom-setting claim.
Draw counts/timing are local bounded browser observations, not device FPS or general GPU performance claims.

Earlier JSON summaries and scripts remain historical checkpoints or preliminary diagnostics. Superseded pre-integration PNGs were removed after review. One earlier bootstrap capture showed Ready and is superseded by the Starting capture in integration-native/bootstrap-320.png.
